items.title_fr: Four “Aura Seeker” Secret Rares Revealed: Blastoise, Hatterene, Hawlucha, Mega Lucario Z ex!
items.summary_fr: Creatures has officially revealed three Illustration Rares and one Special Illustration Rare from Aura Seeker . The set will release in Japan on November 27th. In English we'll get the cards in our Flowing Fists set on February 5th.

items.title_fr: “Wonderful Waters” Mini Tins Revealed for January!
items.summary_fr: A nouveau set of TCG mini tins named "Wonderful Waters" will release on January 29th! As usual, they will cost $9.99 each. They'll include two booster packs, a sticker sheet, an art card of the tin's illustration, and a code card.

items.title_fr: “Aura Seeker” All 78 Main Set Cards Revealed!
items.summary_fr: All 78 main set cards from Aura Seeker have been officially revealed! The set stars Mega Lucario Z ex and will release in Japan on November 27th as their seventh Mega Evolution set. This is the first set to feature the Z Mega Evolutions from the Mega Dimension DLC.

items.title_fr: “Flowing Fists” TCG Set Officially Revealed for February, Full Product Lineup Revealed!
items.summary_fr: Flowing Fists starring Mega Lucario Z ex has now been officially revealed! It will release on Saturday, February 6th as our seventh English Mega Evolution set. This marks the first time a set will release on a Saturday.

items.title_fr: A Shocking Revelation — Can Quad Iron Thorns ex Compete in 2026?
items.summary_fr: Hey PokeBeach readers! It’s Michael, and I am happy to be back with another article. Last time, I discussed a brand new way to play both Mega Charizard X ex and Mega Charizard Y ex alongside some cards from November's Delta Reign.

items.title_fr: “Aura Seeker” Set Starring Mega Lucario Z ex Officially Revealed!
items.summary_fr: Aura Seeker starring Mega Lucario Z ex has now been officially revealed! As posted before, it will release in Japan on November 27th as their M7 set. This is the first set to feature the Z Mega Evolutions from the Mega Dimension DLC.

items.title_fr: Unsettling Silent Hill-Inspired Horror Game Confirmed For Switch 2
items.summary_fr: Ohh God, the teeth. Konami has provided zero indication that it plans to bring any Silent Hill games to the Switch 2, so while we wallow in despair, we can at least take comfort in the knowledge that something remarkably similar is on the way. Revealed at The Horror Game Awards 2026, Ugly Within is published by Serafini Productions and confirmed for Switch 2, PS5, Xbox Series X|S, and PC.

items.title_fr: Jensen Huang Has Been Reinstated As Nvidia's President And CEO
items.summary_fr: Company produces custom processor for Switch 2. Nvidia, one of the largest tech firms in the world and the company responsible for the Switch 2's custom processor, has found itself embroiled in scandal over recent days. As reported by The Guardian , Nvidia's CEO Jensen Huang, who you might recognise from the 'Creator's Voice Special Edition' video for Switch 2, has now resigned after reported affairs with an alleged Chinese spy and a company employee.

items.title_fr: Fantasy RPG 'Sovereign Tower' Brings Some Round Table Management To Switch Next Year
items.summary_fr: Knight's watch. Sovereign Tower launched on Steam earlier this year and quickly picked up its fair share of fans for its wacky round table management. Today, developer Wild Wits and publisher Curve Games have announced that we Switch fans will be able to get in on the fun in the new year.

items.title_fr: "Woke Up To A S**t Show" - Binding Of Isaac Dev Shocked To Find GenAI Music In 'Repentance+'
items.summary_fr: A weekend of review bombing. The Binding of Isaac: Repentance+ was one of a handful of games brave enough to launch on ' GTA Day ' last week, but while Rockstar has been swimming in positive reception ever since, Isaac's re-release hasn't been so lucky. Indeed, the game has been subject to a hefty review bombing from players on Steam after it was discovered that AI-generated music was used in the release's new GTA 6 -themed online mode (thanks for the heads up, Steam Hype ).

items.title_fr: Kirby And The World Beyond Details Revealed In Nintendo Catalogue
items.summary_fr: One of 2027's big-hitters. New details regarding Kirby and the World Beyond have been revealed via Nintendo's winter catalogue in Japan (via Genki_JPN on X). While hardly comprehensive, it provides a little more insight into the game's story along with the abilities and environments available upon its release.
